name: Contact Identification 3
definition: Information needed to contact a physical person.

BIC.name: BIC
BIC.definition: Business Identifier Code to identify the financial institution that the contact person belongs to.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

NamePrefix.name: Name Prefix
NamePrefix.definition: Specifies the terms used to formally address a person.

Role.name: Role
Role.definition: Role of the party in the activity.

PhoneNumber.name: Phone Number
PhoneNumber.definition: Collection of information that identifies a phone number, as defined by telecom services.

FaxNumber.name: Fax Number
FaxNumber.definition: Collection of information that identifies a FAX number, as defined by telecom services.
